# Changelog

## 1.0.2 (2026-11-01)

This patch repairs the launcher runtime gap while retaining the styled terminal
and established conversion, reporting, original protection and exit contracts.

## Offline distribution repair

- The official portable ZIP, ordinary Git clone/`git pull`, and tagged GitHub
  source ZIP carry the same pinned private ImageMagick 7.1.2-35 Beta Q16-HDRI x64
  runtime. Old or absent system ImageMagick no longer determines image startup.
- The source tree tracks one compressed redistributable payload, licenses and
  notices. On its first image run, local bytes are verified before extraction,
  validated in a private temporary sibling and published atomically into a
  per-user cache keyed by application version and payload digest. No download,
  administrator rights, installer or developer staging is required by users.
- The full portable ZIP directly uses its authenticated app-relative runtime and
  omits the redundant compressed payload. One absolute executable plus its
  compatible DLL/configuration set is pinned throughout the run.
- A bare BAT/PS1 pair can reuse only a verified cache matching this version.
  Without trusted bytes it reports the incomplete app directory and the exact
  `WinImgNormalizer-1.0.2-portable.zip` asset before any external decoder executes.
  Damaged recognized releases and policy denials fail closed without fallback.

## Startup diagnostics

Image runs show ENGINE before resolver, integrity or version errors. The terminal
identifies the actual app directory and selected engine path/source/version, or
none, followed by the real rejection. The BAT still resolves its sibling PS1
relative to its own filename, independently of the source folder and Start in.

## Preserved behavior

The default remains 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB), best effort. Orientation, sRGB colour,
white transparency flattening, metadata removal, first-frame/page selection,
collision handling, source preservation, byte-identical videos, cancellation,
native limits, validated JPEGs, logs/CSV and exit 0/1/2/130 remain unchanged.
Empty/video-only folders do not initialize an image engine. Windows PowerShell
5.1 and PowerShell 7 remain supported. Processing stays local with no telemetry,
system PATH, registry, policy or installed software changes.

## Dependency and verification records

The unchanged upstream engine is explicitly identified as Beta. The existing
runtime lock, delegate review, manifest, licenses, notices and corresponding
source sidecars are retained. The application is unsigned; checksums identify
bytes relative to a trusted value, not a verified publisher.

Automated evidence records actual source/asset hashes, native child identity,
synthetic conversion assertions, launcher and shortcut paths, and actual OS/host.
Windows 11 local results and Windows Server hosted results are distinct;
no Windows 10 execution is claimed. See the release's checksums/provenance and
the repository's sanitized HOTFIX-1.0.2 evidence for observed results.
